note: Derived values, recorded when each fixture was accepted. The saves predate the current mod — never check them against C:/RIS.

identical_A.sav.why: Turn 1, no conquests: the parser-determinism pair, and the mod-drift baseline.

identical_B.sav.why: The same game state as identical_A saved a second time — DIFFERENT bytes, identical parse. That is what makes the determinism tests mean something; a byte copy would pass trivially.
